samples.claim: Public FinallyStreamExt<S:Stream>:Stream+Sized exposes finally<F:FnOnce()>(self,f:F)->FinallyStream<Self,F>. Its default body directly constructs the wrapper fields; the blanket impl for S instead forwards through FinallyStream::new. The generic S is the underlying stream type; this is an extension method over owned self, not a callback registration on a borrowed stream.
samples.review_note: Matches trait default construction and blanket forwarding; owned self and generic S are retained.

Constructors do not validate that used_bytes actually exceeds cap; tests below intentionally use cap100/used50. The unvalidated constructor and cap100/used50 recovery fixture are at rust/lance-core/src/error.rs:768-775 and rust/lance-core/src/error.rs:1311-1327.

Private codec constants: magic LSPC, version1, fixed28-byte header, representation0 for dense little-endian u32 grid; unknown future tags are rejected. corrupt wraps messages as CorruptFile named stable_partition_counts. samples.claim: Document both presence states and precise terms. Multiline comments use block syntax for folding, single-line comments use //. ci/check_proto_comments.py, pre-commit, and the Protobuf lint workflow enforce this convention; --fix can rewrite offenders.

samples.review_note: Matches documentation rule and named checker/workflow as guide claims, without claiming execution.

samples.claim: The Path implementation clones self into a working full_path, then for each supplied path.parts() replaces it with full_path.clone().child(part), returning the final value. Repeated whole-path clones are explicit; absolute-path, escaping and normalization semantics are not reimplemented here. No local tests are defined.

Documentation requires monotonically increasing inputs and says state is reused. Public struct holds private Arc<DeletionVector>, left search bound and last_diff; new initializes both cached u32 numbers to zero. There is no fragment physical-row-count field or total-row bound.

samples.claim: FixedSizeList has dimension uint32=1, items ArrayEncoding=2, and has_validity bool=3. Compression specifies string scheme=1 and optional signed level=2; the schema does not enumerate supported scheme strings, levels, or defaults.
samples.review_note: Matches fixed-list fields/tags and open-ended scheme/optional signed level declaration.

samples.claim: Public SharedStream::new(inner:BoxStream<'a,T>,capacity:Capacity)->(Self,Self) creates optional Semaphore with capacity as usize, empty counters/queue, no poller/waker, non-exhausted state and two live side flags; both returned handles share one Arc. There is no validation of Bounded(0). Zero capacity prevents acquiring the first permit and therefore prevents polling upstream, even after the peer is dropped because acquisition still precedes the peer-liveness check.
samples.review_note: Matches constructor state; additionally read poll155-224 to confirm permit acquisition precedes peer-liveness handling, so zero bounded capacity does not recover when peer drops.

samples.claim: Structural encodings are called layouts. RepDefLayer records each peeled list/struct layer's interpretation: UNSPECIFIED=0 is invalid/debug; ALL_VALID_ITEM=1, ALL_VALID_LIST=2, NULLABLE_ITEM=3, NULLABLE_LIST=4 (null but no empty lists), EMPTYABLE_LIST=5 (empty but no null), NULL_AND_EMPTY_LIST=6. ITEM includes primitives or structs. Null and empty list layers are distinct even when neither emits a child value.
samples.review_note: Matches structural layer meaning and all numeric enum values; null/empty distinction retained.

samples.claim: CompactRemapStep::get extracts high32 fragment and low32 offset. Missing fragment returns outer None; an offset >= supplied physical rows also returns None. Missing retained offset inside a covered fragment returns Some(None). A present offset produces preceding-retained-count + zero-based rank, uses group_idx to locate its destination layout, and returns Some(Some(new address)). Without physical counts, every absent offset in a listed fragment is treated as deleted.
samples.review_note: Matches all tri-state get branches and optional physical bound.

samples.claim: Field Display prints id, name and logical type, optional Debug dictionary metadata and recursively formatted children, with a trailing comma/space after each child. It omits parent_id, nullability, encoding, most metadata and key-position members, so Display output is not a full serialized schema or equality key.
samples.review_note: Matches Display fields, recursive child formatting and omission list.

samples.claim: FromIterator takes the iterator lower size_hint bound as first block capacity when positive, otherwise one, then pushes each item. It always allocates a block through with_capacity, so even collecting an empty iterator yields len=0 but is_empty=false. The default growth limit remains zero. A misleading upstream lower bound can affect allocation size; no extra cap is applied.
samples.review_note: Matches lower size hint, capacity fallback and iteration. Additionally read with_capacity and is_empty to confirm allocated-empty block means is_empty false.

samples.claim: Private tests use FutureExt, PanicHookInfo and Tokio. spawn_cpu_reraises_the_closure_panic temporarily replaces the global panic hook, triggers an &str panic inside spawn_cpu, awaits through tokio::spawn, restores the hook, and checks the original payload. This confirms the intended contract in test source; there is no serial guard around the process-wide hook manipulation in this file. Test runtime execution was not performed.
samples.review_note: FAIL: panic-test behavior matches, but no PanicHookInfo import exists. Module imports only super::*; FutureExt is available through the parent import atline8 and Tokio paths are qualified. Remove invented import and keep actual panic-hook lifecycle.

samples.claim: path_str returns a newly allocated String, unwraps path.to_str (non-Unicode can panic), and on cfg!(windows) replaces every backslash with slash; other targets clone the path text unchanged. The comment calls this safe to use as a URI on Windows, but the function does not add a URI scheme or perform URL percent-encoding.
samples.review_note: Matches cfg!(windows), backslash replacement, Unicode unwrap and unchanged non-Windows text; URI encoding is not performed.

samples.claim: Fsst uses one page-wide symbol table stored in bytes symbol_table=1 and CompressiveEncoding values=2 for the transformed variable-width block. The contract calls the transform transparent. It does not specify symbol-table serialization or the FSST algorithm itself.

samples.claim: FinallyStream's Stream<Item=S::Item>::poll_next projects the pinned upstream, forwards the poll, and takes/invokes callback only on Ready(None). Callback executes synchronously at first observed EOF, at most once even on repeated EOF. Pending and Some(Err(...)) do not count as EOF. Early wrapper drop simply destroys the closure without calling it. Callback panics are not caught.
samples.review_note: Matches pinned forwarding, take-on-EOF and synchronous at-most-once callback; no Drop callback or panic catch.
